# LockCoverPhoto — DUPLICATED ASSET

`lockcover-photo.jpg` is a downscaled copy of:

    assets/login/Picture3.jpg

**There are now two copies of this image in the repo, and they are not linked.**
Changing the login background does NOT change the lock cover, and vice versa.
If Picture3 is ever replaced, this file has to be regenerated by hand:

    sips -Z 1600 assets/login/Picture3.jpg \
      --out ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/LockCoverPhoto.imageset/lockcover-photo.jpg
    sips -s formatOptions 72 \
      ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/LockCoverPhoto.imageset/lockcover-photo.jpg \
      --out ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/LockCoverPhoto.imageset/lockcover-photo.jpg

## Why a copy exists at all

The lock cover is native Swift (`ApexLockCoverPlugin.swift`). `assets/` is web
content served to the WebView and is not reachable from UIKit, so the image has
to live in the asset catalog to be loadable at all.

## Why it is downscaled

The original is 3696x2448 / 1.2 MB. The cover's entire job is to be on screen
before the WebView can paint, so decoding a 9-megapixel JPEG anywhere near the
launch path is the one thing that must not happen. At 1600px wide / ~325 KB it
still comfortably exceeds the largest iPhone's physical pixel width, and it is
behind a 55% black scrim.

The decode is additionally done off the main thread and cached per process; the
cover paints its solid #141210 immediately either way.
